## What this changes

<!-- One or two sentences. For a correction, say what happened in practice that the current text got wrong. -->

## Type

- [ ] Correction to an existing skill
- [ ] New skill
- [ ] Documentation or repository housekeeping

## Checklist

- [ ] `python3 scripts/validate-skills.py` passes locally
- [ ] Written in English, no emoji
- [ ] No fabricated limits, versions, or behaviour — everything stated is verified

<!-- For a new skill, also: -->

- [ ] The description starts with "Use when…" and lists concrete phrasings
- [ ] The description says what the skill does **not** cover, and points at the skill that does
- [ ] `SKILL.md` is a router; the depth is in `reference/`
- [ ] The directory name matches the `name` field exactly
- [ ] A `README.md` for the skill folder
- [ ] The catalogue in the root `README.md` and the category `README.md` are updated

## Scoping

<!-- For a new skill: which existing skill is it closest to, and where is the line between them? -->
